vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: openclaw-usage-dashboard
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is a utility for generating a local HTML dashboard to track LLM API usage and costs from OpenClaw session logs. The Python script (usage-dashboard-generic.py) uses only standard libraries to parse local JSONL files and optionally queries the official Anthropic API to retrieve rate-limit quotas using the user's environment variables. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, obfuscation, or malicious intent; the code aligns perfectly with the functionality described in SKILL.md and README.

llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it says — it reads local OpenClaw session transcripts and generates a local HTML cost/usage dashboard; its requirements and behavior are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the included script and instructions: the tool reads OpenClaw session transcripts, computes token/cost metrics and produces a local HTML dashboard. Declared provider support and pricing data are implemented in the script's PRICES dictionary; no unrelated credentials or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions and the script explicitly read session files from ~/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions (or OPENCLAW_ROOT override) and openclaw.json for model config — this is required for the stated purpose. This does mean the skill will parse local session transcripts, which may contain sensitive user data; the SKILL.md notes optional use of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for live quota gauges. There is no obvious instruction to send data to external endpoints, but you should review the remainder of the script to confirm there are no network calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only with included script) — nothing is downloaded or written by an installer. The provided Python script appears to be stdlib-only as claimed, so no external package installs are required.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only environment interaction is reading OPENCLAW_ROOT (to locate sessions) and optionally ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for quota gauges per SKILL.md. Those variables are proportionate to the stated functionality. The script does not request unrelated keys or config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is user-invocable and not always-enabled; it does not request elevated/always-on privileges or modify other skills. It runs as a one-off script and does not declare persistent system changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally coherent and appears to do only local analysis of OpenClaw session logs. Before installing or running it, consider: 1) Inspect the full script (especially the truncated portion) to confirm there are no network calls or hidden upload endpoints; 2) If your session transcripts contain private data, run the script locally (or use --demo) rather than on a shared machine; 3) If you don't want live quota polling, avoid setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or review how the key would be used; 4) Prefer running the script in an isolated environment (local user account or container) if you cannot audit the full source. If you'd like, I can scan the remainder of the script for network/socket usage, subprocess execution, or other risky operations — provide the full file text and I'll check it line-by-line.
